prompt: In split.py, split_bill(total_cents, weights) must divide total_cents (an int) among the weights so that the returned list of ints always sums to exactly total_cents. Each share is proportional to its weight; use the largest-remainder method: give every share its floor first, then hand out the remaining cents one each to the shares with the largest fractional remainders, breaking ties in favour of the earlier index. A weight of 0 gets 0. Raise ValueError if weights is empty, if any weight is negative, if all weights are zero, or if total_cents is negative. The weights argument must not be modified.
